verdict.rationale: Several community reports describe kitty as very fast and responsive, including low CPU during high-speed scrolling and latency on par with Terminal.app [kitty-comm-3, kitty-comm-5, kitty-comm-11, kitty-comm-12, kitty-comm-20]. A dispute is not possible because the first-party docs in the pack never describe GPU rendering, so all the evidence is community-tier, and it is mixed: one user found catting a long file 100x slower than Terminal.app [kitty-comm-4], and another reported it fails on many Nvidia laptops [kitty-comm-6]. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the GPU-accelerated rendering pipeline, reproducible throughput benchmarks under heavy output, and resolution of the reported slow-draw and Nvidia GPU compatibility failures.
